messages.subject: multicore plyr?
parts:
I have a CPU bound job for which I'm using plyr. The tasks are wonderfully parallelizable[1] I have an 8-core amd64 machine and I'd like the job to use 7 cores.

I see the multicore package, which provides the mapply function, is there anyway to use plyr as an interface to that? Or another way to use multiple cores?

I searched the manipulatr google groups archive for multicore, but didn't find anything. I note that the plyr article does mention this as future work, if there's anything I can test please let me know.

Thanks,
James

[1]: Why be embarrassed? ;)

messages.subject: Re: multicore plyr?
parts:
I don't know about multicore use with plyr, but there is a post in learning R blog about another package similar to plyr but with the capability to make use of parallization. See: http://learnr.wordpress.com/2009/08/12/block-processing-a-data-frame-with-plyr/
I hope that is useful
Luciano
